topicTitle: 6.1 Role of Hormones in Male and Female Sexual Development
answer: Testosterone, produced mainly by specific testis cells, supports development of male reproductive organs, maturation of sperm and secondary sexual characteristics such as facial hair, deeper voice and increased muscle mass.
prompt: What is the role of testosterone in male sexual development?

answer: Gametogenesis is production of specialized sex cells called gametes in reproductive organs; meiosis halves the chromosome number. In males it is spermatogenesis, and in females it is oogenesis.
Asexual reproduction produces offspring from a single parent without gametes; the offspring are genetically identical clones of the parent.
The mother contributes only an X chromosome, whereas the father contributes either X or Y. XX produces a female child and XY produces a male child, so the sperm chromosome determines the combination.
